{{Quote|What was that?''"<br />"''A Trade Federation gunship.''"<br />"''Well, what's it doing here?''"<br />"''I don't know.|[[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] on Obredaan|<ref name="SW:OW" />}}
A '''Trade Federation gunship''' was a class of [[Starship/Legends|starship]] used by the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] around [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]]. One of the vessels appeared at the end of a [[Second mission to Obredaan|mission]] to [[Obredaan]], suggesting to the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] a link between the Trade Federation and the [[Jin'ha]] warriors.<ref name="SW:OW" /> The class was also used by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Several were present on [[Vjun/Legends|Vjun]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].<ref name="Yoda" />

==Behind the scenes==
Trade Federation gunships first appeared in the [[2001]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars: Obi-Wan (video game)|''Star Wars: Obi-Wan'']]. They also appeared later in [[2004]] in the novel ''[[Yoda: Dark Rendezvous]]'', written by [[Sean Stewart]].
